title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
description: Cal (Steve Carell) and Emily have the perfect life together living the American dream...until Emily asks for a divorce. Now Cal has to navigate the single scene with a little help from his professional bachelor friend Jacob (Ryan Gosling).
note:
Just an overall feel-good amazing movie yk. I tend to watch it whenever yk i feel "alone" (oh great another lonely man in the big 2026 ik) but yeah it makes me feel happy that things might indeed just turn out okay for everyone and it's ok to be cringe (ig not sure if it's just Hollywood being Hollywood tbh) coz cringe isn't really absolute it's relative. 

I love Ryan Gosling in this - plays his role perfectly and his motivations too. I love every fkn movie Steve Carell is in too lmao. He's such a perfect father character and you always root for him. He's just a nice guy who's going through some shit coz he lost his way somewhere along the line but he always remembered his way back and all it took was a wake-up call that he's indeed lost and has to go back home.

And the fkn soundtrack OMFG it just hits EVERY SINGLE TIME.
